text: As high-level exchanges continue, businesses are watching whether talks yield a more stable, predictable operating environment. Zheng Yi, president of the Shanghai American Chamber of Commerce, said stability in trade policy and export controls would reduce operating uncertainty
text_zh: 随着高层交流持续进行，企业正在观望会谈能否带来更稳定、可预测的经营环境。上海美国商会会长郑艺表示，贸易政策和出口管制的稳定将减少经营不确定性。
